doc.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000

title: Opening, the Mayflower hotel and comedians Sol has worked with
summary: Introductions, joking about the hotel, and Sol mentions shows with Jackie Mason, Henny Youngman, Alan King and others.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming —
Sol Yaged — he’s killing me already. We are at one of Sol’s favorite hotels, the Mayflower in Manhattan.
I know the hotel very well, I spent a week here one night. Don’t use that Tim.
I’m wondering if you could have had a dual career as a comedian, or do you work it in in what you do?

Well I played in shows with people like Jackie Mason, Henny Youngman, Buddy Hackett, Don Rickles. I played many, many years ago up in the Catskills with George Burns, Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, I did shows with them. So all these things rub off. I did a show a few weeks ago with Alan King at the Friar’s Club. You know Jackie Mason Tim? Tim? You changed your name?
You’ve got to ignore me here. You talk to him.
You know who Jackie Mason is?
I had lunch with him at the Friar’s Club.
And he picked up the check.
Yeah, then he handed it to me.
